title: Rebind IFX P10.1 to published V4 Guards 1.1.4 and run one C6c
goal: Create and qualify a new deterministic 0.4.0 IFX candidate bound to immutable V4 Guards 1.1.4, then attempt exactly one complete C6c and stop.
acceptanceCriteria: The published 1.1.4 tag, source, archive, receipt, manifest and Package identities match the frozen values without modifying the installation.
A clean exact IFX Target commit is frozen and used by all refreshed locks, inventory, bundle lineage, workspace evidence and reports.
A module/authority/adapter/dependency-lock inheritance matrix preserves unchanged C1-C5 evidence and routes only the seven changed consumers through focused qualification.
The installed 1.1.4 Host workspace-evidence schema and input contract are exactly compatible with all seven consumers.
A new 0.4.0 candidate declares workspaceEvidence, binds all 1.1.4 identities, refreshes inventories and locks, and is deterministic across two independent builds/compositions.

The seven consumers prove Host-evidence/direct-scan semantic equivalence and fail closed for the required tamper, commit, missing/stale, path/link, capability and configuration negatives using declared timeouts.
Exactly one full C6c is attempted after low-cost gates pass; Windows, controls and Linux portability evidence are preserved and phase 1 stops without repair or rerun.
